admin.help:
🛠️ *Admin Commands*

*QUICK_ADD <name>|<desc>|<price>|<stock>* — add product
   Example: QUICK_ADD iPhone 15|Latest phone|3500000|25

*ORDERS* — view all pending orders
*ORDERS APPROVED* — filter by status
*APPROVE <order>* — approve an order
*REJECT <order> <reason>* — reject an order
*PAY <order>* — request payment from customer
*CONFIRM_PAYMENT <order> <method> <ref>* — confirm payment
*DELIVER <order> [note]* — mark as delivered
*TRACK <order>* — view order details
*PRODUCTS* — list all products
*HELP* — show this menu

landing.hero_desc: Track inventory, receive WhatsApp orders, monitor sales, and grow your business with AI-powered automation.
landing.features_desc: A complete platform with everything to run your WhatsApp business.
landing.feature_1_desc: Customers message you, AI responds instantly.
landing.feature_2_desc: Track orders from request to delivery.
landing.feature_6_desc: Track expenses and manage credit sales.
landing.feature_7_desc: Send promotions to customers in bulk.
landing.how_desc: Create your account, connect WhatsApp, and start selling in minutes.
landing.step_1_desc: Create your free account for your business in 60 seconds.
landing.step_2_desc: Link your WhatsApp number with one QR scan.
landing.step_3_desc: Receive orders and manage inventory instantly.
landing.wa_desc: Customers message you on WhatsApp, and AI responds instantly — taking orders, confirming payments, and providing delivery updates.
landing.pricing_desc: Choose the plan that fits you
landing.faq_desc: Got questions? We answered the common ones.
landing.faq_1_a: You sign up, connect your WhatsApp by scanning a QR code, and start receiving orders through your dashboard.
landing.faq_2_a: Yes. We use HTTPS encryption, your data is stored securely, and we never share your data with third parties.
landing.faq_3_q: Can I use it on my phone?
landing.faq_3_a: Yes! You can download our Android app and install it on your phone. Our dashboard also works great in your browser.
landing.faq_4_q: How long is the free trial?
landing.faq_4_a: The free plan has no time limit. You can use the free plan as long as you want.
landing.faq_5_q: How do I pay for a paid plan?
landing.faq_5_a: You can pay via M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, or Airtel Money. Your payments are secure and confirmed instantly.
landing.faq_6_q: Can I cancel my plan anytime?
landing.faq_6_a: Yes. You can cancel your plan anytime without paying any fees.
landing.faq_7_a: Yes, you need an internet connection to use UZANITE.
landing.faq_8_a: Yes! You can add staff members and give them different roles.
landing.cta_desc: Join 500+ businesses already growing with smart inventory management.
